text:
[LSER.8.6.1] When a fact assertion both updates series state
and triggers rule pattern re-evaluation, the where-clause
aggregation reads see the **pre-sample** series snapshot —
the state as of the start of the pump, before ANY sample
absorbed in it. RHS actions running in the same pump see the
same snapshot; the post-sample state is what the NEXT pump
reads.

The scope is the pump, not the assertion. Two facts asserted
before one pump both fire against the pre-sample snapshot, so
a rule firing for the second does not see the first's sample.
